svg.title: Lagrange Tides V3 — Kinetic Braided Currents (bottom)
svg.desc: A living estuary of refractive glass and energetic tides: twin overlapping animated plasma ribbon volumes translate in counterphase, continuously weave in depth, morph their contours, and breathe. Guided photons flow along independent tracks while refracted thread filaments, optical flashes, auroral nebulae, and pulsating highlights drift across the crown. All original V1 and V2 artwork is preserved; reduced-motion mode retains complete static V2 art.
